## 自动判断网络

<div id="videoContainer-sample-1">
  <p>请稍等，正在根据您的网络加载播放器……</p>
</div>
<script>
(function(container) {
  function loadBilibiliVideo() {
      const videoHtml = `<div style="position: relative; padding: 30% 45%;"><iframe style="position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; left: 0; top: 0;" src="https://player.bilibili.com/player.html?bvid=BV1xx411c7mD&page=1&high_quality=1&danmaku=0" frameborder="no" scrolling="no"></iframe></div><br>`;
      return videoHtml;}
  function loadYouTubeVideo() {
      const videoHtml = `<div style="position: relative; padding: 30% 45%;"><iframe style="position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; left: 0; top: 0;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/dQw4w9WgXcQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe></div><br>`;
      return videoHtml;}
  checkGoogle().then(function(status) {
  if (status === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = loadBilibiliVideo();
  } else {
        container.innerHTML = loadYouTubeVideo();
    }
  });
})(document.currentScript ? document.currentScript.previousElementSibling : document.getElementById("videoContainer-sample-1"));
</script>
